messages:
brynn: Postmortem follow-up: recurring auth-service alert noise during scale tests. Two distinct buckets: quick bursty spikes (1-4m) that repeatedly page, and slow degradations (>10m) that need faster detection. We need owners, timeline, and clear handoffs so this doesn't slip.

brynn: Proposed mini-plan: 1) Short-term: adjust alert config to avoid paging on micro-blips. 2) Medium-term: dedupe + fingerprinting by trace/session. 3) Policy: quiet-hours for non-prod. 4) Runbook + CI smoke job. 5) Tracker + SLA for repeat occurrences.

brynn: Call out owners and conservative ETAs.

omar: I'll take 1) (alert change). Suggest: require p99 > 650ms for 3/5 windows (5m). Will run historical backtest. ETA: 16h.

jeff: I'll pair with Omar to do a safety rollback alert in case the threshold hides a real outage. I'll own that check and a short escalation rule. ETA: 24h.

oncall-bot: Ticket created: TKT-9911 "auth alert tuning + rollback-check" assigned to omar, jeff.

rachel: I'll own 2) dedupe + fingerprint. Current dedupe is 90s; propose 5m for auth-timeout plus fingerprint by trace_id/session_id and exclude internal-bot label. ETA: 36h.

sam: I'll implement 3) quiet-hours on non-prod routes (23:00-07:00) and add a config note for daylight-saving. ETA: 2h.

brynn: For 4) runbook + CI smoke, do we want a simple k6 profile or a unit test in the auth repo?

rachel: CI smoke should be a separate job using k6 to simulate bursty RPS; runbook will include the curl + how to verify traces. I can draft runbook text; owner for adding CI job?

sam: I can add a pipeline job blueprint and hand it to the auth repo owners to add. ETA for blueprint: 48h.

jeff: Important: when we increase dedupe we must still have a rapid path for sustained incidents: if error_rate > 4% for 8m, bypass dedupe and page. I'll add that to the alert graph and the PR.

omar: Noted. I'll share the backtest query: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(auth_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and a small script to reproduce the windows.

rachel: Also adding fingerprint will require ensuring traces aren't sampled away; I'll include fallback on session_id.

brynn: OK recapping owners: omar=1(16h), jeff=rollback-check(24h), rachel=2(36h), sam=3+pipeline-blueprint(2h/48h), brynn=tracker+SLA follow-up(6h). If any swaps please call out.

jeff: I'll open the alert PR and tag oncall for review.

omar: PR draft for threshold test: https://redwood/repo/alerts/pull/1234. Will add results of the backtest.

sam: Quiet-hours PR: https://redwood/repo/alerts/pull/1237, merging shortly.

rachel: Ticket for dedupe work: TKT-9915, linking in tracker.

brynn: I'll create the tracker sheet and seed it with these entries and timelines. Link in ~1h. We'll review progress in 48h in this thread. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
